name: B10-0436/2025 (ECR) – Humanitarian and security situation in Haiti, in particular the rising power of criminal gangs and the recent massacre in Cabaret
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the humanitarian and security situation in Haiti, in particular the rising power of criminal gangs and the recent massacre in Cabaret
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking for action on Haiti's crisis, where criminal gangs have taken over large areas and violence has forced many people from their homes. It calls on Haiti's authorities to restore security and the rule of law, and on the European Union and other countries to send more humanitarian aid and support Haitian security forces. It also asks Haiti's government to investigate the Cabaret massacre, where dozens of civilians were killed, and bring those responsible to justice. This is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- The text asks for more aid and support for Haiti's security forces; no law changes.
- It affects Haiti's people, its government, and the European Union and other international partners.
- Next, the resolution is sent to the Council, the Commission, Haiti's government and others.
